prs.title: Fix pre_parse_json corrupting str | None values that look like JSON
prs.author: vientooscuro
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs fix the same bug in func_metadata.py's pre_parse_json: it JSON-decodes string parameter values before validation whenever the field's annotation isn't exactly `str`. For Union annotations that include `str` (e.g. `str | None`), this corrupts legitimate string values that happen to look like JSON (e.g. a JSON payload intentionally passed as a plain string gets silently turned into a dict/list). (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs fix the same bug in func_metadata.py's pre_parse_json: it JSON-decodes string parameter values before validation whenever the field's annotation isn't exactly `str`. For Union annotations that include `str` (e.g. `str | None`), this corrupts legitimate string values that happen to look like JSON (e.g. a JSON payload intentionally passed as a plain string gets silently turned into a dict/list). (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: 3056 unwraps `Annotated[...]` before inspecting union members (_unwrap_annotated), so it correctly skips pre-parsing for the common `Annotated[str, Field(description=...)] | None`-style described parameters; 2032's _should_pre_parse_json compares raw union args against a fixed {str,int,float,bool,None} set with no Annotated-unwrapping, so an Annotated member fails that equality check and the corruption bug persists for that pattern. 2032 is also broader than the reported bug: it disables pre-parsing for any all-simple-type union (e.g. `str | int`, `str | bool`), which changes behavior for numeric-ish unions that legitimately rely on JSON-decoding a numeric string; 3056 intentionally restricts the skip to `str | None` only (per its own docstring), which is a narrower, lower-risk fix that matches the specific corruption case being reported without altering pre-parsing for other union shapes.

clusters.pick_reason: 3056 unwraps `Annotated[...]` before inspecting union members (_unwrap_annotated), so it correctly skips pre-parsing for the common `Annotated[str, Field(description=...)] | None`-style described parameters; 2032's _should_pre_parse_json compares raw union args against a fixed {str,int,float,bool,None} set with no Annotated-unwrapping, so an Annotated member fails that equality check and the corruption bug persists for that pattern. 2032 is also broader than the reported bug: it disables pre-parsing for any all-simple-type union (e.g. `str | int`, `str | bool`), which changes behavior for numeric-ish unions that legitimately rely on JSON-decoding a numeric string; 3056 intentionally restricts the skip to `str | None` only (per its own docstring), which is a narrower, lower-risk fix that matches the specific corruption case being reported without altering pre-parsing for other union shapes.
